name: Idealista API
tagline: Iberian property listings and market data for Spain, Portugal, and Italy
description: Idealista provides real-estate listing search and market data across Spain, Portugal, and Italy. Access is typically partner/business oriented rather than fully self-serve; authentication, endpoints, and pricing should be verified against current official developer documentation before integration.

auth.details: Partner/business access; authentication method not fully confirmed from public docs in this pass — verify OAuth/API credentials with Idealista before use.

use_cases: search property listings by location and filters in Spain
get listing details for a property code
query market statistics for a municipality
filter homes by price, size, and operation (sale/rent)
find properties near coordinates within a radius
